title: AI Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Systems Engineer to lead the development and deployment of advanced artificial intelligence solutions within our organization. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and software development, with a focus on integrating AI capabilities into scalable, secure, and efficient platforms. As an AI Systems Engineer, you will collaborate across teams to design, implement, and optimize AI-driven applications and services that meet our strategic objectives and enhance operational performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable AI systems leveraging cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and OpenStack to support enterprise-level applications.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet to automate deployment processes and manage cloud infrastructure efficiently.
* Develop and maintain microservices architectures utilizing containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes to ensure system scalability and resilience.
* Integrate various cloud services including S3 storage, Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS solutions to optimize data flow and system performance.
* Collaborate with software developers to build RESTful APIs and web services that facilitate seamless communication between AI models and client applications.
* Manage identity and access management (IAM) solutions to ensure secure access controls across cloud environments.
* Conduct system hardening, security assessments, and performance tuning to uphold high standards of reliability, security, and compliance within cloud infrastructure.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in managing IT infrastructure within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Rackspace, or Citrix.
* Strong knowledge of service-oriented architecture (SOA), distributed systems, virtualization technologies like VMware, and cloud management tools.
* Proficiency in programming languages including Python, Java, Go, Ruby on Rails, PowerShell, Bash scripting, or Node.js for software development and automation tasks.
* Hands-on experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Docker for deploying scalable applications.
* Familiarity with database management systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, NoSQL databases like Cassandra or MongoDB.
* Expertise in DevOps automation practices involving Jenkins, Git version control system, CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet for continuous integration and deployment workflows.
* Knowledge of operating systems including Linux/Unix/Windows environments along with virtualization techniques like Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and VPNs for secure connectivity.
* Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals related to algorithms, system architecture design, REST APIs, web services development, and application security best practices.

Join us in shaping the future of intelligent systems by harnessing cutting-edge cloud technologies to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale!

Pay: $37.43 - $45.08 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Miami, FL 33135

title: CAD Administrator
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Role**

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
* Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
* Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
* Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
* Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
* Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
* Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
* Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
* Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
* CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
* Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
* Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
* Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
* Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
* Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
* Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI/data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.

We’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Washington Post for six straight years and named to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming home for those looking to grow and contribute to positive change. We encourage all employees to expand beyond their boundaries, dive into important world-changing Federal challenges.

**Position Summary**

Credence has an immediate need for **a Senior AI Software Engineer** to join our growing AI and Automation practice. In this role, you will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI-driven solutions, including generative AI, LLM-powered applications, and agentic AI systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering, data, cloud, and stakeholder teams to deliver scalable, secure, and mission-focused AI capabilities for federal clients, while helping guide technical direction, strengthen engineering practices, and mentor other engineers.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below**

* **Generative AI & LLM Solution Delivery**  
  Lead the design, development, prototyping, and refinement of AI-powered capabilities using generative AI, large language models, retrieval patterns, prompt/context engineering, and secure API integrations.
* **Agentic AI System Development**  
  Own end-to-end agentic AI development lifecycles, including model selection, agent design, tool/function calling, orchestration, response synthesis, evaluation, and deployment of reliable AI agents.
* **Senior Software Engineering Leadership**  
  Apply strong software engineering principles to design maintainable, testable, and scalable systems; conduct code reviews, establish technical patterns, and leverage AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate delivery.
* **Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration**  
  Partner with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, cloud engineers, and mission stakeholders to translate business and mission needs into operational AI and automation solutions.
* **Cloud Enablement & DevSecOps Integration**  
  Design and automate deployment workflows using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, containers, and cloud-native services to support secure, repeatable, and scalable AI delivery.
* **Production Monitoring & Optimization**  
  Monitor AI systems post-deployment, perform performance tuning, and apply best practices for reliability and scalability.
* **Technical Rigor & Documentation**  
  Write clean, well-documented code following industry and federal guidelines; support reproducible development.
* **Technical Mentorship & Continuous Improvement**  
  Stay current on emerging AI/ML trends, agentic frameworks, model capabilities, and engineering practices while mentoring team members and contributing to reusable standards, documentation, and technical design reviews.

  
**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience delivering AI/ML, generative AI, or LLM-powered solutions in production or production-like environments.
* Experience building generative AI applications, working with LLMs, implementing tool/function calling, and applying model evaluation, prompt/context engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation approaches.
* Experience designing or implementing agentic AI solutions using frameworks or platforms such as Agent2Agent Protocol, Bedrock Agents, Mastra, CrewAI, Strands, AgentCore, LangChain, or LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of leading AI APIs and model platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI.
* Proficiency in TypeScript and familiarity with key libraries and frameworks such as Nx, Next.js, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK, Playwright, Jest, and Vite.
* Python proficiency and familiarity with libraries and frameworks (uv, Pydantic, FastAPI, CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph, Unstructured).
* Demonstrated curiosity and practical experimentation with emerging AI technologies, with a strong focus on responsible innovation and measurable mission impact.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI)
* Experience with VS Code and AI extensions such as Cline and Claude Code.
* Strong communication skills and client-oriented mindset.
* U.S. Citizenship with eligibility for DoD Secret clearance.

**Preferred**

* Curious and experimental about the latest innovations in AI with an orientation toward the relentless pursuit of delivering mission impact.
* Exposure to adjacent skillsets such as data engineering, data science, UI/UX, cloud engineering, and platform engineering to understand the entire software ecosystem.
* Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Open Tofu, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation to deploy cloud native applications.
* Knowledge of federal cybersecurity, RMF, FedRAMP, or regulatory frameworks.

**Why This Role Matters**

* **Real-World Impact** — Your work will support defense and health agencies where AI solutions directly contribute to national security and public well-being.
* **Growth-Oriented Technical Leadership** — Work with technical leaders, shape agentic AI delivery practices, and mentor team members while continuing to deepen your own expertise in advanced AI engineering.
* **Culture of Empowerment** — You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, trust, collaboration, and mission success.

**Salary Range:** $155,000 - $200,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, education, certifications, skills, and overall qualifications.

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term & Long Term Disability
* Training & Development
* Wellness Resources

You'll work in a continuous feedback loop with the software organization: collecting input, designing and developing scalable automation frameworks across web, Android, and Windows, and shipping working reliable MVPs — deployed through modern GitLab CI/CD pipelines — that you refine based on real team usage and feedback. You'll help set the standard for how our Quality Engineers use AI to design tests, increase coverage, and review code, personally building the prototypes and reference implementations the broader organization adopts and relies on. We're looking for real usage, not familiarity from a demo or a single trial.

* Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field (required by contract).
* Practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred, but equivalents welcome).
* Solid understanding of software design patterns and foundational architectural principles.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and drive adoption of frameworks, tools, or best practices across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with modern requirements and issue management tools (Jira, Jama, Rally, or similar).
* Clear, effective communication skills — written, verbal, and cross-team.

* A consultative, problem solving mindset — someone who can sit with a team, uncover the true challenge, and design an elegant, effective solution.

title: NX Developer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Team**

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains internal systems, applications, and infrastructure across the enterprise. We are looking for an NX Developer to join our team and develop customizations, automation, and administrative tooling for our Siemens NX CAD environment.

### **About the Role**

Anduril's engineers design and build autonomous systems that protect those who serve. Behind every model, drawing, and assembly is the Siemens NX environment that makes rapid iteration possible. As an NX Developer on the Engineering Systems and Tools team, you'll be the person who makes that environment faster, smarter, and more reliable — building custom automation, tooling, and integrations that let our mechanical and electrical engineers focus on the work that matters instead of fighting their tools. You'll write real code (NXOpen API, Python, C++), own the full lifecycle of internal developer tools, and work directly with the engineers who depend on them. This isn't IT support - it's product development for an internal user base that's building things that actually matter.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain NX Open API customizations (NX Open C/C++, NX Open Python, NX Open .NET) to automate repetitive design tasks and enforce engineering standards
* Build and manage NX CAD administrative tools including templates, part families, reuse libraries, and check-mate rules to ensure consistency across the engineering organization
* Create custom NX dialogs, menus, and toolbars that streamline workflows for mechanical and electrical design teams
* Develop journal-based automation scripts and NX Open applications to accelerate modeling, drafting, and BOM generation processes
* Collaborate with PLM engineers to ensure seamless NX–Teamcenter integration in managed mode, including classification, naming rules, and revision workflows
* Work with a high-functioning team of solution engineers and cross-functional teams with an emphasis on finishing business-critical projects
* Help troubleshoot NX technical issues including those related to deployment, site configuration, custom toolkit distribution, and ongoing end-user support

**Who You Are:**  
Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology startup that is rapidly scaling itself. Our culture is one of ambition, hard work, relentless pursuit of excellence, and deliberate disruption. The successful candidate will be one who demonstrates the follow core characteristics:

* **Outcome-Oriented** - they determine what benefits the business needs and work backwards from those outcomes. The antiquated IT concept of "system availability" is abhorrent to the ideal candidate, they care about if the business actually got value from their product, not if it was just made to specification
* **Customer Focused** - they display user empathy to boost engagement and build experiences that delight
* **Strong Product Sense** - they know when in the product's lifecycle to focus on optimizing the end user experience and when to focus on enterprise-level functionality
* **Dive Deep** - they sweat the details and roll up their sleeves to uncover the root causes for systemic issues, be it technical shortfalls or lack of user comprehension of a product
* **Ownership** - they care deeply not just about their products, but for all the business outcomes that their systems supports as well, holding themselves accountable for everything it both does and fails to do
* **Agility** - they change directions easily and without regret, quickly adapting to shifting business priorities
* **First Principles Thinking** - they approach problems and develop solutions not based on what a vendor recommends or because it's how they did things at their last job, but from a deep appreciation of what is best for the enterprise
* **Exceptional strategic problem-solving capabilities** - adept at navigating complex technical trade-offs

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in a CAD development role, ideally in a fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environment
* Degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical degree
* Proficiency in NX Open API development using one or more of: C/C++, Python, Java, or .NET (C#/VB.NET)
* Hands-on experience with NX CAD administration including templates, drafting standards, part families, reuse libraries, and role-based configurations
* Experience creating and maintaining NX journaling scripts and custom automation toolkits
* Strong understanding of CAD data management concepts including naming conventions, revision control, and BOM structures
* Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints

**Preferred QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter integration in NX managed mode, including classification, workflows, and naming rules
* Familiarity with NX Check-Mate for automated design validation and quality checks
* Experience with NX deployment and site-level configuration (ugii\_env, custom directories, toolkit distribution)
* Knowledge of GRIP or KF (Knowledge Fusion) programming within NX
* Experience integrating CAD tools with downstream systems (PLM, ERP, MES, etc.)
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve user issues, and work autonomously to solve problems

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
***Note:*** *Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.*

**Our Story**
-------------

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Repairers train for years to be on the tools, then spend half their day on quotes, paperwork and finding parts. Partly's product aims to automate the admin so repairers can focus on their craft. The products we've launched this year start with a conversation, and behind it a system generates the interface the moment needs. So we no longer design a set of pages. We design components, and then we design the brain the AI uses to assemble them. Very few designers have done this yet. That's the opportunity: to work out what product design becomes at an AI company, in a domain where a wrong answer is a $1,000 part that can't be returned.

The problems are real and unsolved. How does someone who's never used a chat interface know what to ask when they land on an empty box between phone calls? How does a task you do forty times a day become one tap, not one more sentence to type, with the same result every time? How much of the agent's reasoning do you show before trust turns into a wall of text? Where should the interface be opinionated, and where should it be generated? We don't have the answers yet. You'll own finding Partly's.

**The role**
============

Our product teams are organised around a product, each led by a Product Lead (Principal Product Manager) with a Product Engineer and a mix of engineers. Design is not embedded in those teams. We're building a global design team that works across all of our products and is focused on three things: the design system everything is built from, coherence across the whole product family, and the quality of the experience wherever a repairer or supplier meets us. Our customers range from repairers and parts admins in a single independent workshop to multi-billion-dollar repair groups, and the suppliers who provide their parts. The team exists to drive adoption and stickiness through experiences that feel magical, in a way that works for our customers. We work collaboratively with the Product Leads who drive their products.

This is a senior design role for someone with incredible judgement and hands-on experience with AI surfaces and experiences. You lead with design: problem framing, systems thinking, interaction and craft. And you make things real, with working prototypes built inside our design system.

You won't sit in a product team's backlog. Product Leads own their products and what ships. You own the principles, patterns and system they build from, and you set your own agenda for where those need to go next. When something ships below the bar, you're the one who says so.

This role is based in one of our offices: Auckland or Christchurch in New Zealand, London in the UK, or Austin, Texas in the US. The design team works across all of them.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own the design system that engineers and coding agents build our AI experiences from.** Components, patterns, rules and guidance that read correctly to an engineer and to a coding agent, so the right choice is the default even when you're not in the room.
* **Shape and ship the patterns for agentic and generative experiences.** Natural language where conversation fits, generated UI where the data is dense, and agents that take on the admin, verification and sourcing around a repair while the person keeps the decisions that matter.
* **Define how the product behaves when it's uncertain.** When the agent acts, proposes or asks, in line with the cost of being wrong. How it shows its work, how a person corrects it, and who's right when they disagree.
* **Give the product its character.** How our agents speak to a repairer, their tone, when they're brief and when they explain. A personality people recognise on every surface where they meet us.
* **Hold the bar across every product.** Notice when the same job looks different in two products and fix it at the source, in the system rather than page by page. Measure adoption and quality, and hold teams to them.
* **Work with real prototypes.** Build working versions with AI tools inside our design system, test them on real data, and put them in front of repairers and suppliers.
* **Pair with engineers, no hand-offs.** Work directly with Product Engineers and their teams, polish the details together, and review the UI that coding agents produce from the system.
* **Spend real time with customers.** In the workshop, on the phone and in the product, running research alongside the Product Leads who hold the deep customer context in each region.
* **Write the principles and rules.** How the experience behaves on behalf of a person, written clearly enough that an engineer and a model can both follow them.

**What you bring**
------------------

* **Senior experience, evidenced.** You've been trusted to run a project end to end and can point to the user behaviour that changed because of it. Typically 5+ years designing complex software; the evidence matters more than the years.
* **You've designed agentic experiences, and can show the work.** Shipped at work or built seriously on your own time. Tasks, tools, autonomy, human-in-the-loop, evaluation: you've made real calls on what an agent does alone, what it proposes and what it asks, and you can tell us which of those calls were wrong.
* **Systems thinking.** You've contributed to or built a design system that engineers reached for without being told to, and you have a view on what a system needs to be when its heaviest user is a coding agent.
* **Craft that holds up in production.** Real states, real edge cases, real data. Deep fluency in interaction design, copy that carries its weight, and the visual taste to make a dense, technical tool look considered.
* **Product judgement.** You can take a fuzzy brief and produce the problem, the constraints and the first testable version, and you can explain a trade-off you made and who disagreed. You build to learn, and you know when your prototype is lying to you.
* **Comfort working with several product teams at once,** respecting that each Product Lead drives their product while bringing a view that spans all of them, and comfortable telling them when it isn't good enough yet.
* **Curiosity about our customers.** Professionals with high expectations, low tolerance for friction, and workflows shaped by decades of industry convention.
* **Clear written, verbal and visual communication.**

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience designing workflow-heavy, data-dense or technically complex B2B products.
* Marketplace, catalogue, e-commerce or supply chain domains. Automotive is a bonus, not a requirement.
* High-growth startup and scale-up environments.
* Experience working in a global, distributed design team.

We're not looking for a designer whose strength is producing a hundred screens in a traditional SaaS model, or one who is apprehensive about AI. If half the work makes you nervous, this isn't the role.

**How we build**
----------------

We're an AI research company and we build like one. In discovery mode, anyone, designers included, can use Claude Code to build a working version inside our design system, run it against real data, and show a customer the feature with their own jobs in flight. In scale mode, engineering rebuilds what's proven. We don't ship prototype code to production; we use it to decide what production should be. Designers work in both.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

* **Healthy, Catered Lunches** - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London and San Francisco offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)
* **Healthy Body, Healthy Mind** - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such gym memberships, rock climbing, physio, massage, GP visits, prescriptions; anything that you or your family, need!
* **Family Comes First** - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work (four days on full pay for your first three months back).
* **Getting Here Is On Us** - If you commute to a Partly office or co-working space, choose from a paid 24/7 car park or commute allowance. One less thing to think about!
* **Workspaces That Inspire** - Our brand new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes a few steps away.
* **Office-First with Flexibility** - In cities where we have an office (Christchurch, Auckland, London, San Francisco), we default there every day. This let's us move faster, make better decisions and build strong relationships. We also operate with a very high trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life, and flex your schedule to get your best work done.
* **We Celebrate Together** - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

title: Test Systems Engineer
description:
**About Dexmate**
-----------------

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for Test Systems Engineers to build the machines that test our robots and to keep our new test lab running. You will design automated test rigs, data logging, and dashboards so durability tests can run around the clock, and you will run whole-robot functional and working-condition tests that reflect how customers actually use our robots. You are the force multiplier: the more you automate, the more the team can test.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, and maintain automated test stations and rigs combining mechanical fixtures, motors, sensors, PLCs or microcontrollers, and software
* Build data acquisition and logging systems, and dashboards that track test status and results across all test stations
* Automate long-duration durability and duty-cycle tests to run unattended overnight and on weekends, with alerts and automatic shutdown on failure — scaling to dozens of modules on test in parallel
* Qualify every test station for accuracy, repeatability, and stability before its data is trusted
* Design simple interface boards and harnesses for test setups, and work with equipment suppliers on custom stations
* Run whole-robot functional tests: mobility, manipulation, payload, terrain, and continuous operation
* Develop and run working-condition tests based on real customer scenarios and environments
* Assemble, configure, and prepare robots and subsystems for testing
* Keep the lab running: equipment setup and calibration, spare parts and inventory, and lab safety (battery handling, robot motion safety zones)
* Support mechanical and electrical test engineers in executing their test plans

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* BS in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 3+ years building test equipment, automation, or robotic systems
* Proficiency in Python for automation and data handling, and comfort with Linux command line
* Hands-on experience with sensors, motors, and DAQ or PLC systems
* Comfortable with mechanical assembly, wiring, and basic fabrication
* Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ROS/ROS 2 or robot middleware
* Experience building test dashboards and databases
* Background in robotics competitions, makerspaces, or building robots end-to-end
* Experience running a hardware lab, including equipment calibration and safety programs

You will set how mechanical testing is done at Dexmate, and your sign-off will decide whether hardware is ready to ship.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time in the lab — building fixtures, instrumenting hardware, running tests, and tearing down parts yourself. We care most about what you have actually built, tested, and broken.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Translate real customer usage profiles into lab test specs and reliability targets, even when field data is still limited
* Define and execute mechanical validation plans for robot structures, joints, actuators, gearboxes, bushings, end effectors, and mobile bases at component, subsystem, and full-robot level
* Run strength, stiffness, stability, and tip-over tests; drop, impact, and collision tests; and static and dynamic load tests
* Design and run accelerated life and durability tests on joints, actuators, cables, and wear components, including continuous duty-cycle runs on full robots
* Run environmental tests — vibration, shock, thermal cycling, humidity, and dust/water ingress — in-house or with external labs
* Design and build test fixtures, jigs, and stands (CAD through fabrication)
* Instrument tests with strain gauges, load cells, torque sensors, encoders, and DAQ; analyze and report results
* Correlate test data with FEA/CAE models and feed findings back to design engineers
* Lead mechanical failure analysis: teardowns, root cause, corrective action, and verification of fixes; build and maintain a failure-mode database that feeds back into design
* Turn test data into statistical risk assessments (e.g., Weibull life estimates) and present clear ship/no-ship recommendations to leadership
* Work with suppliers on part-level qualification and with outside labs on certification testing
* Write clear test procedures that technicians and our Shenzhen team can run consistently

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience — proven test work matters more to us than the degree
* 4+ years of hands-on experience in mechanical test, validation, or reliability engineering for robotics, automotive, aerospace, industrial equipment, or consumer hardware
* Hands-on with shop tools and comfortable building your own test setups
* Hands-on experience instrumenting tests with strain gauges, load cells, and DAQ systems
* Experience designing and running fatigue, durability, or accelerated life tests
* Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape, or equivalent) for fixture design
* Strong root-cause analysis skills and clear technical writing

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience testing actuators, gearboxes (harmonic, planetary, cycloidal), or legged/wheeled robots
* Experience with vibration, shock, thermal, and IP testing and relevant standards (IEC 60068, IEC 60529)
* Familiarity with FEA and test-to-simulation correlation
* Knowledge of reliability methods: FMEA, Weibull analysis, HALT/HASS
* Python, MATLAB, or JMP for test data analysis
* Experience with failure analysis tools such as X-ray/CT, microscopy, or cross-sectioning
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers in Asia
